located_proof_sources.quote: The full unknown-gain, first-local-motion entangler question remains unresolved in both blocks. All six returns say this correctly. I found substantial valid partial results, with different domains: barriers for a completed commuting scalar library, adversarial noise for fixed weak native words, finite coarse approximations in block 1, and an all-native action bound in one block 2 return. These domains must remain separate when comparing returns.
